notes:
Background: OutboundFuse builds sales engagement automation for mid-market SaaS firms. Heavy outbound SDR workflows + live chat agent that can execute CRM/email/calendar actions via tool-calling. Primary ask: sub-250ms median token latency for streaming responses and <500ms end-to-end tool-call roundtrip for simple CRM writes.

Call highlights: VP Product (Marina Park) - "We need streaming first-token latencies that feel real-time for reps. If streaming lags, adoption drops." Head of Sales (Erik Lowe) - wants direct HubSpot/Salesforce CRUD from the agent and calendar invites without bounced events.

POC plan: start with Hosted API integration (websocket streaming + function-calls shim) -> run 10k simulated outbound interactions (mix of short prompts + tool-calls) -> measure median p50/p95 token latency, tool-call RT, error rate. If metrics meet SLOs and unit-cost fits model, move to Dedicated for predictable throughput.

Security/compliance: Needs KMS integration for customer keys, audit logging for all tool-calls, and data residency preference (US-only) for PII. Legal flagged retention controls.

People: AE Jordan Meyers, SE Priya Raman, Product lead Marina Park, Head of Sales Erik Lowe. No CSM yet (post-contract).

Quotes: "If you can show us stable p95 under 800ms for complex tool sequences we'll be in serious discussions."
